title: Inert declaration allowlist v1
description: Recorded state of the declared-but-unread configuration defect class. Every entry must state why the declaration is acceptable as it stands; the gate fails on an empty reason, on an undocumented finding, and on a stale entry.

operator_kwarg_models.description: AppConfig-reachable models that are extra="allow": their fields are an operator keyword bag consumed by a provider chosen at run time, so a name-mention scan cannot see a reader. Derived from the models and cross-checked in both directions by the gate.

declaration_only_keys.description: Gate A allowlist: config keys read only by the module that declares them. Must equal the scan's finding set exactly.

unreachable_flags.description: Gate B allowlist: enabled-shaped flags whose subsystem production never reaches. Must equal the scan's finding set exactly.

known_blind_spots.description: Keys an audit believes are inert that the gate cannot prove, each with why the gate cannot see it. Gate B errs toward under-reporting, never toward a false build failure; this list is what keeps that honest and keeps the blind spot from being re-discovered as if it were new.

reported_defects.description: Inert declarations found by audit that this guard does not measure. Recorded so the defect class has one register; each module must still exist, so fixing one means deleting its entry.

reason.description: A written justification. minLength 1 is enforced by the schema AND re-checked by the gate, because a whitespace-only reason is the failure mode a reviewer cannot see.
